title: Gemini candidates can mix text and functionCall parts in any order
answers: Gemini tool call missing when the response also has text
AI Gateway Gemini returns 500 KeyError functionCall on mixed response
text before function call dropped from Gemini chat response
Gemini streaming tool call lost leading text
body:
Symptom: A Gemini chat response through the AI Gateway drops the tool call, or fails with a 500, when the model answers with text plus a function call in the same candidate. The leading text (e.g. "Let me look that up.") is also lost.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:GeminiAdapter.model_to_chat and GeminiAdapter.model_to_chat_streaming only tested parts[0] for functionCall, so a text-first candidate took the text-only path. GeminiAdapter._convert_function_call_to_openai_choice read part["functionCall"] on every part, so a text part raised KeyError.
Fix pattern: Choose the tool-call path with any(part.get("functionCall") for part in parts). In _convert_function_call_to_openai_choice, read text parts into a list, skip parts without functionCall via part.get, and set content="".join(text_parts) or None on both the message and the stream delta.
Constraints: Text-only candidates must keep the original path. Do not go back to parts[0] or part["functionCall"] indexing on the mixed path. _VertexGeminiAdapter inherits these methods, so the same change covers Vertex AI.
Applies: Any change to Gemini (or Gemini-shaped, including Vertex) response parsing in the AI Gateway providers, for both chat and streaming.
applies: Gemini and Vertex AI response conversion in mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py.
says: Gemini chat crashes with an error when answering with both text and tools.
Introductory text is missing when a Gemini model triggers a tool call.
Tool calls are dropped from the response if the assistant writes text first.
Streaming chat responses from Gemini lose the explanation before running a tool.
Preserve both message text and function calls in Gemini and Vertex AI responses.
search: Gemini and Vertex AI response parsing in mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py must support candidates mixing text and functionCall parts in any order for chat and streaming. The tool-call path must be chosen using any(part.get('functionCall') for part in parts) in GeminiAdapter.model_to_chat and GeminiAdapter.model_to_chat_streaming rather than inspecting only parts[0]. In GeminiAdapter._convert_function_call_to_openai_choice, text parts are joined into content, skipping parts without functionCall via part.get to avoid KeyError. Text-only candidates must keep the original path, and changes apply to _VertexGeminiAdapter through inheritance.
